author: bradlightcap
text: Our team changed, and changed again. As did our board. But our mission hasn't. Excited to have @sama and @gdb back in the fold alongside me, @miramurati, and the entire OpenAI team. I look forward to building for the future with @btaylor, @LHSummers, and @adamdangelo.

quoted.text: Sam Altman is back as CEO, Mira Murati as CTO and Greg Brockman as President. OpenAI has a new initial board. Messages from @sama and board chair @btaylor https://t.co/sP0kAQIeKg
